requested_order.text: Wegovy (semaglutide) 0.25 mg SC once weekly x4 weeks, then titrate per label to 2.4 mg weekly

adjunct_diet_and_activity.text:
A/P:
1. Obesity, BMI 35.8 — plan starting today:
 - Reduced-calorie meal plan of about 1500 kcal/day with food logging in a phone app.
 - Brisk walking with a coworker at lunch 3 days a week.
 - Enrolled in the health system's 12-month lifestyle modification program.
 Follow-up in ~3 months.
2. Low back pain — stable.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 01/03/2026
Lifestyle program intake. Food log: cafeteria lunches (fried entrees), chips/cookies in the evening, large weekend brunches.
Plan: ~1500 kcal/day logged in phone app; bring lunch 3x/week, cafeteria choices with grilled protein + vegetables; planned evening snack ≤150 kcal.
Activity: brisk walking with coworker at lunch 3 days/week.
RD follow-up 6 weeks.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 03/11/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the meal plan and lunchtime walks started in December; logs most days. Good adherence most weeks.
O: Wt 97.0 kg, BMI 35.6. BP 124/66.
A/P:
1. Obesity — continue program.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 05/26/2026
Food log reviewed: adherent most days, ~1500 kcal. Lunches packed most days.
Adjustments: protein at breakfast to reduce mid-morning hunger; lighter weekend brunch choices.
Reports keeping up with lunchtime walks 3 days/week.
Continue program.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/18/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and program visits since December — logging meals, lunchtime walks. Frustrated: weight 95.6 kg today vs 97.5 kg when the plan began (-1.9%) despite reported adherence. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis. Medication list not reconciled today — patient did not bring her list and pharmacy records were not available.
O: Wt 95.6 kg, BMI 35.1. BP 114/78.
